worst: A: omits const/static elision (implicit 'static) and default trait-object bound rules; only says trait objects follow separate rules
worst_summary_quote: Trait object lifetimes follow separate rules.
worst_page_quote: Both constant and static declarations of reference types have implicit 'static lifetimes unless an explicit lifetime is specified.
reader_gets_wrong: A reader would not learn that references in const/static items are elided to 'static, though the three core function rules are stated correctly.
notes: Core three rules accurate. Minor B: calls the Nomicon an older, more detailed version, but it lacks the trait-object and const/static sections the Reference has. Compared Reference, googlesource copy, w3cub copy, MIT Reference, MIT Nomicon.
